title: Connect a paragraph without stock phrases
instructions: Improve cohesion in the charity-sale composition. Body paragraph one shows how the initial task plan made the workload manageable. Body paragraph two shows how the same method supported adaptation after rain. Answer all six questions before viewing feedback.

parts.prompt: Which sentence order creates the clearest given-to-new progression for the rain paragraph?

options.text: The group moved the electrical equipment first. Rain forced the stalls indoors. This showed adaptation. Water was approaching an extension lead.

Rain forced the stalls indoors. During the move, water began approaching an extension lead. That safety risk made the electrical equipment the first priority. Handling one priority at a time showed how the method supported calm adaptation.
Firstly, it rained. Secondly, there was equipment. Thirdly, this happened. Finally, the method was useful.
The method supported adaptation. The extension lead existed. Charity sales need stalls. Rain is a kind of weather.

choice_rationales.A: The effect appears before its cause, and ‘this’ has no secure referent.
choice_rationales.B: Each sentence begins from established information and advances through disruption, risk, decision and significance.
choice_rationales.C: Ordering labels cannot replace the missing causal and referential relationships.
choice_rationales.D: The sentences share a broad topic but do not form a usable logical route.

parts.hint: Track what each sentence receives from the previous sentence and what new information it adds.
parts.correct_explanation: The sequence moves from rain to the resulting risk, then from that risk to the priority decision and its significance.

parts.prompt: Which THREE phrases create the clearest reference chain after ‘Water was spreading towards an extension lead’ ?

options.text: the approaching water
that safety risk
the decision to move electrical equipment first
it
this thing

choice_rationales.A: This repeats the relevant noun precisely while the risk is being established.
choice_rationales.B: This summarises why the water matters and creates a bridge to the response.
choice_rationales.C: This names the resulting action clearly enough to support later explanation.
choice_rationales.D: With water and an extension lead both present, the bare pronoun can be ambiguous.
choice_rationales.E: The vague phrase does not tell the reader which event or object is being carried forward.

parts.hint: Choose phrases whose referents remain certain even when several objects and actions are present.
parts.correct_explanation: The selected phrases form a precise chain from condition to risk to decision without forcing the reader to guess what a pronoun means.

parts.prompt: Which transition best completes the real relationship? ‘The checklist exposed an unconfirmed drinks order. ___, the group contacted the supplier while there was still time to act.’

options.text: However
For example
As a result
Meanwhile

choice_rationales.A: The second sentence is not a contrast with the discovery.
choice_rationales.B: Contacting the supplier is a consequence, not an example of the order itself.
choice_rationales.C: The contact follows directly because the checklist revealed the unfinished task.
choice_rationales.D: The central relationship is causal rather than merely simultaneous.

parts.hint: Name the relationship between discovering the problem and taking the next action.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘As a result’ accurately signals that the discovery caused the group to contact the supplier.

parts.prompt: Which revision repairs the cohesion problem rather than simply adding more connectors?

options.text: Firstly, the rain began. Moreover, water neared the cable. Furthermore, we moved things. Finally, it worked.
Rain forced the stalls indoors, where water began approaching an extension lead. Because that risk could not wait, the group moved electrical equipment before decorations.
The rain began. In addition, additionally, furthermore and moreover, we acted.
The rain began. Nevertheless, this thing led to stuff, and consequently it was cohesive.

choice_rationales.A: Stock ordering and addition words leave the risk and decision relationship unexplained.
choice_rationales.B: The revision names the location, the safety risk and the cause of the priority decision.
choice_rationales.C: Connector stacking adds noise without supplying a logical step.
choice_rationales.D: The transition, references and nouns remain vague or inaccurate.

parts.hint: Choose the revision that restores a specific reference and a reason for the action.
parts.correct_explanation: The cohesive revision repairs the underlying cause-and-response chain instead of decorating disconnected statements.

parts.prompt: Which thread-word chain preserves one central idea without mechanical repetition or synonym drift?

options.text: step-by-step method → one priority at a time → clear next action
method → scheme → trick → magic
organisation → orange poster → grey cloud → school wall
plan → plan → plan → plan, with no further meaning added

choice_rationales.A: The phrases vary naturally while developing the same idea of manageable decisions.
choice_rationales.B: The substitutions change meaning and eventually make an unreasonable claim.
choice_rationales.C: The concrete nouns belong to unrelated details rather than one conceptual thread.
choice_rationales.D: Repetition can aid clarity, but this chain adds no development.

parts.hint: Look for variation that deepens one concept rather than replacing it with unrelated or inaccurate language.
parts.correct_explanation: The selected chain keeps the method visible while showing what it does at progressively more specific levels.

parts.prompt: Which sentence best supplies the missing logical step? ‘The rain forced every stall into the hall. ___. Therefore, the group moved electrical equipment before decorations.’

options.text: During the move, water began spreading towards an extension lead, creating an immediate safety risk.
The poster lettering was orange and one helper wore blue shoes.
Firstly, secondly and finally are common linking words.
Decorations can be found in many colours and shapes.

choice_rationales.A: This explains why the electrical equipment had to become the first priority.
choice_rationales.B: The decorative observations do not cause the priority decision.
choice_rationales.C: A comment about linking words does not belong in the event sequence.
choice_rationales.D: The general statement neither establishes urgency nor advances the paragraph.

parts.hint: Identify the cause needed to justify the priority introduced by ‘therefore’.
parts.correct_explanation: The safety risk is the necessary bridge between moving indoors and prioritising electrical equipment.
